    AI Overview
    A 2026 E! documentary series titled
    "Dirty Rotten Scandals" examines allegations of a hostile work environment, sexual harassment, and discrimination during Bob Barker's 35-year tenure as host of The Price Is Right. The documentary, which premiered in March 2026, features interviews with former models—known as "Barker's Beauties"—and crew members. 
    Key Aspects of the Documentary 
    • Allegations: Former models including Holly Hallstrom, Kathleen Bradley, and former producer Barbara Hunter speak out about alleged harassment and a toxic culture on set.
    • Retaliation Claims: Holly Hallstrom alleges in the series that she was fired in 1995 after refusing to speak out in defense of Barker during a sexual harassment lawsuit filed by another model, Dian Parkinson.
    • The Producer's Defense: Longtime The Price Is Right producer Roger Dobkowitz has criticized the documentary as a "hit piece," defending Barker's tenure.
    • Focus of the Series: The Dirty Rotten Scandals series investigates the "dark side" of several long-running television shows. 
    Other Projects 
    • "Perfect Bid: The Contestant Who Knew Too Much" (2017): A separate award-winning documentary that focuses on Ted Slauson, a super-fan who memorized product prices and was involved in a 2008 scandal. 
    Note: The information above is based on reports regarding the 2026 "Dirty Rotten Scandals" documentary series.

    Perfect Bid: The Contestant Who Knew Too Much
     (2017) is the primary documentary concerning The Price Is Right, focusing on fan Ted Slauson, who memorized product prices and helped a contestant achieve a perfect showcase bid in 2008. It has been available on Netflix, though availability can change. 
    Key Details About "Perfect Bid" (2017): 
    • Subject: Ted Slauson, a superfan who attended over 37 tapings, was banned from the show after helping contestant Terry Kniess make a perfect bid in 2008.
    • Content: The film covers the 2008 showcase scandal where Kniess bid exactly
      , a result of years of analyzing item prices.
    • Interviews:
      Features interviews with Ted Slauson, producer Roger Dobkowitz, and host Bob Barker.
       
    Other Potential "Price Is Right" Content: 
    • Dirty Rotten Scandals (2026): A docuseries, featured in early 2026 on E!, that investigates the darker side of The Price Is Right including claims of harassment and retaliation.
    • Availability: Perfect Bid is sometimes available on Netflix, Prime Video, or Apple TV. 
    Perfect Bid is described as a well-executed 70-minute documentary.
